title: A Month That Had Not Happened
subtitle: 改变与成长 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 改变与成长（做人与做事·改变与成长）
meta: 主题语境：改变与成长（做人与做事·改变与成长）　|　核心词汇：advance　|　正文 355 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 advance 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1965 my grandfather asked for a month's wages ① in advance, which the factory had never done in thirty-one years and did once, for him, and never again. He called it an ② advance on the year, not on the wages, and my grandmother said the difference was the whole of the argument and that she had lost it; an advance, she said, is money you borrow from a month that has not happened.

There had been ③ no advance in the shop since 1946, by which he meant the machines, and he said the word belongs to two things, money and machines, and never to people. The ④ advance of the road in 1968 took the front off nine houses and half of his, and he said advance is what you call it when the thing is coming at you.

In 1971 the price of flour went up ten times in nine months, and he said an ⑤ advance of that kind is not progress and should not be called by the same word. He wrote the numbers in the margin of a book he had been given in 1931, in ⑥ advance of any of them, meaning he had left the page blank for forty years and then used it; every advance in the price, he said, is a retreat somewhere else.

He asked for ⑦ an advance of nine pounds in 1974 and was refused, and he said the refusal was the first true thing the factory had told him in ten years. The ⑧ advance he had wanted was not the money but the month, and he never said so, and my grandmother said she had known it since 1965 and had never once mentioned it, because an advance, she said, is never about the money.

The ⑨ advance I would put in the margin, if the book were mine, is not the road or the flour or the nine pounds refused, but the blank page kept for forty years. An ⑩ advance, he told me in 1981, is the future coming at you a month early, and every advance is paid back by somebody who did not borrow it.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: C. n. （工资等的）预付款；预支款
E. 固定搭配：in advance 提前；预先
F. 固定搭配：in advance of ... 先于；在……之前
G. 固定搭配：advance in ... 在……方面的进展
H. 固定搭配：an advance on ... ……的预支／预付款

items.q: no advance in the shop since 1946
The advance of the road in 1968
an advance of that kind is not progress
in advance of any of them
an advance of nine pounds in 1974
The advance I would put in the margin
An advance, he told me in 1981

answers.why: in advance 意为“提前、预先”，1965 年祖父要求预支一个月的工资。
an advance on ... 意为“……的预支”，他说这是对一年的预支，而不是对工资的预支。
advance in ... 意为“在……方面的进展”，他说自 1946 年以来厂里的机器毫无进展。
advance 意为“前进、推进”，1968 年道路的推进拆掉了九户人家的门面。
advance 意为“（价格的）上涨”，1971 年面粉价格九个月里涨了十次，他说这种上涨不是进步。
in advance of ... 意为“先于、在……之前”，他把数字写在一本 1931 年送他的书的页边，比任何数字都早了四十年。
an advance of ... 意为“……的预付款”，1974 年他请求预支九英镑，被拒绝了。
advance 意为“预支”，他想要的不是钱而是那个月，而这一点他从未说出口。
advance 意为“进展、进步”，若那本书归我，我会写进页边的进展是那张留了四十年的空白页。
advance 意为“前进、推进”，他说所谓提前，就是未来提早一个月朝你走来。

task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。

他说那是对一年的预支，而不是对工资的预支。（an advance on）
